g.text: Takeaway: shared-bundle routing packs 26 devices into 1.8 mm² — 11.5× smaller than the 20.7 mm² side-by-side tiling.

g.text: Bundle runs between coupler rows at 3 µm centre-to-centre; overflow outside past 16 pairs; left-most-to-left-most keeps probes apart.
